copy.heading: What was the question?
copy.instructions: For each question, circle the answer that answers it.

blocks.text: 1. Lauren: "What time will you be home?"

items: a. "Depends if the second court comes free."
c. "Did you know it's the fastest-growing sport in the world?"
a. "Busy. We've got a big client in."
c. "We're doing padel for the Christmas do, if I win the vote."

blocks.text: 3. Mia: "Daddy, can we go to the park?"

items: c. "The park near the club has a lovely view of the courts."

blocks.text: 4. Priya: "Have you finished the deck for Thursday?"

items: c. "Which Thursday? I've got padel on Thursday."

blocks.text: The answers are b, a, b and a. If you circled c for question 3, Mia has asked us to tell you she is not cross, just disappointed.
